label: Hip-hop and rap
why: Rap vocals are mixed dry and upfront with the 808 centred; space comes from ad-libs thrown to the sides and rear, not from reverb on the lead.

objects.name: lead_vocal
objects.why: The lead vocal stays where the artist put it, front and centre, and never moves. Dry and close.

objects.name: adlibs
objects.why: Ad-libs and doubles to the sides and behind.

objects.name: kit
objects.why: Kick and snare centred and dry.

objects.name: hats
objects.why: Hats sway gently across the front, a small, tempo-locked movement.

objects.name: bass
objects.why: Above the crossover the bass stays centred and close; below it the original passes untouched. The 808 stays put.

objects.name: beat
objects.why: Samples and keys wide in front.

_about: Genre template (decision 0017). Azimuths in degrees, positive to the LEFT (SOFA convention), elevation up, distances in metres. spread is the angle between the object's two virtual sources; wide gives the spread and elevation it opens to in open sections. motion paths: orbit (a full turn per period when depth is 360), sway (back and forth by depth degrees), scaled by the listener's motion depth and capped at 45 degrees per second. protected objects never move.
